_comment: Play phone screenshots, rendered in array order by render.mjs. `capture` is a file in captures/<game lang>/ (tools/store_shots.gd on mobile-spike). Wrap a phrase in ==double equals== to set it on the gold marker. Captions are burned into the PNG.

captions.en-US: Guard the builders ==as the waves come==
captions.es-419: Protejan a los constructores ==cuando llegan las oleadas==
captions.pt-BR: Protejam os construtores ==quando as ondas chegam==

captions.en-US: Up to four friends ==with one room code==
captions.es-419: Hasta cuatro amigos ==con un código de sala==
captions.pt-BR: Até quatro amigos ==com um código de sala==
captions.de-DE: Bis zu vier Freunde ==mit einem Raumcode==

captions.en-US: Raise ==watch posts== and keep them in stones
captions.es-419: Levanten ==puestos de guardia== y que no falten piedras
captions.pt-BR: Ergam ==postos de guarda== e não deixem faltar pedras
captions.de-DE: Errichtet ==Wachposten== und versorgt sie mit Steinen

captions.en-US: Finish the stretch ==before the stars appear==
captions.es-419: Terminen el tramo ==antes de que salgan las estrellas==
captions.pt-BR: Terminem o trecho ==antes de as estrelas aparecerem==
captions.de-DE: Vollendet den Abschnitt, ==bevor die Sterne aufgehen==

captions.en-US: 52 days, ==straight from the book of Nehemiah==
